verdict.rationale: Proa templates are Rust macros: the GitHub README says the macro validates the template at compile time. The docs describe typed Rust components and editor tooling with Rust go-to-definition, hover, completion and rename inside `md!` templates, and paired views get flagged when a field is missing. Together these indicate type-aware checking inside templates, not just surrounding code. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that dynamic expressions/props inside templates are rustc type-checked with example errors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
